about.intro: Supporting Orthodox Christian students in their academic and spiritual journey, grounded in the life and teaching of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church.

learn.title: Learn
learn.description: Access authentic Orthodox teachings, Scripture studies, and theological resources.

grow.title: Grow
grow.description: Deepen your prayer life and spiritual practice with guided resources.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Join a vibrant community of Orthodox students supporting one another.

mission.title: Forming hearts and minds in Christ on campus.
mission.body1: The Orthodox Resource Center exists to give university students easy access to trustworthy Orthodox resources—Scripture, teachings, liturgy, and spiritual guidance—so that faith can grow in the middle of academic life.
mission.body2: Through curated content, prayer tools, and community initiatives, the center helps students integrate their Orthodox faith with study, friendship, and service.
